person: Saoirse Malik, second-year psychology student at Rowanbank University in Glasgow, part-time barista at Thistle & Bean café and treasurer of the Rowanbank Hillwalking Society

mail.subject: PSY2004 essay – deadline and word count
mail.body: Dear all, the PSY2004 essay on memory and sleep is due in two weeks, on the Monday at 12 noon, through the coursework portal. The word limit is 2,500 words, plus or minus 10%. Late submissions lose 5 marks per day. Best, Dr Galbraith

mail.subject: Rota for the next three weeks
mail.body: Hi all, rota attached. Saoirse: Thursdays 16:00–20:00 and Saturdays and Sundays 08:00–14:00, except the weekend of your hiking trip, which you've got off. Shout by Friday if anything doesn't work. Niamh

mail.subject: Swap Saturday?
mail.body: Hey Saoirse, any chance you could take my Friday close (16:00–22:00) this week and I take your Saturday morning? My cousin's wedding is on Saturday. No worries if not! Kofi

mail.subject: Your payslip is ready
mail.body: Your payslip for last month is ready. Hours worked: 62. Gross pay: £706.80. Net pay: £671.20. Your next pay date is in 4 weeks.

mail.subject: Overdue item
mail.body: The following item is now overdue: Foundations of Cognitive Neuroscience (3rd edition), barcode 30118842. Fines are 20p per day. Please return or renew it as soon as possible.

mail.subject: Re: Extension request
mail.body: Hi Saoirse, given your shifts and the society trip, I can give you a 3-day extension on the PSY2004 essay. Your new deadline is 3 days after the original one, at the same time. Best, HG

mail.subject: Committee minutes
mail.body: Minutes: 1) Glen Ardach trip confirmed, 24 places. 2) Treasurer (Saoirse) to collect £45 per member. 3) Ceilidh tickets £8 for members, £12 for non-members. 4) Next committee meeting in Union Room 3 at 18:00. Callum (President)

mail.subject: Group booking GA-4471 confirmed
mail.body: Dear Saoirse, your group booking for 24 people for 2 nights is confirmed. Arrival from 16:00 on the Friday, departure by 10:00 on the Sunday. Total £1,152; your £300 deposit is paid and the balance is due 7 days before arrival. The door key code will be emailed the day before you arrive. Bedding is not provided.

mail.subject: Booking CM-0928
mail.body: Two 16-seat minibuses are booked for collection at 15:00 on the Friday from our Kessock Road depot, to be returned by 18:00 on the Sunday. Drivers must be over 21 and have held a full licence for at least 2 years. Total £396, paid. Fuel is not included.

mail.subject: Glen Ardach payments
mail.body: Hey treasurer, from the sign-up sheet I think 17 people have paid the £45 so far. Can you check the society account and chase the rest before the bunkhouse balance is due? We also need two minibus drivers: I can do one, can you ask Hana? C

mail.subject: Society grant approved
mail.body: The Hillwalking Society's grant application has been approved: £250 towards transport for the Glen Ardach trip. The money will reach the society account within 5 working days. Receipts must be submitted within 30 days after the trip.

mail.subject: Re: driving the minibus
mail.body: Hi! Callum said you might ask. Happy to drive one of the minibuses, but I've only had my licence for 18 months, is that ok? x

mail.subject: PSY2011 lab report groups
mail.body: Your lab group for the reaction time study is Saoirse Malik, Diego Alvarez, Freya Lindqvist and Tunde Bakare. The lab report is due in 3 weeks, limit 3,000 words. Lab sessions are in Lab 2.14.

mail.subject: lab report split
mail.body: hey team, proposal: i do methods, freya does intro, tunde does results, saoirse does discussion + references. can we meet next monday at 2 to merge drafts?

mail.subject: Your exam timetable
mail.body: PSY2004 Memory & Cognition: 2 hours, Hall A, seat 112. PSY2011 Research Methods: 1.5 hours, Sports Hall, seat 47. Exact dates are on your student portal.
